scope: 62 raw log files only; all PNG/JSON and historical conclusions retained
containerResolution: Resolve containerRelativePath from the workspace container containing both the canonical checkout and output; a worktree parent is not the container
recovery: Verify copies using check-evidence-manifest.mjs and restore only to a new empty directory. Original Git blobs remain at sourceCommit/sourcePath.
